# Little Poppin

> Original hand-illustrated nursery and children's wall art, sold as instant digital
> downloads worldwide, or printed to order and posted from the production partner nearest
> you. Also personalised name prints, printable activity books, and premium bamboo swaddles.

Little Poppin is a small family business based in Australia, shipping worldwide. It is a
brand of Wild Hearts Publishing Pty Ltd.

## What is actually for sale

- **93 original art prints** across four collections. Nursery (41), Little Zodiac (12),
  Magical Academia (20) and Festive (20). Every print is a high-resolution PNG, 4:5 ratio,
  around 300 DPI, which prints cleanly at 8x10 and 16x20 inches. AUD $12 each.
- **18 gallery sets** of three prints designed to hang together. AUD $30.
- **5 collections**, the complete Zodiac ($69), Festive ($89), Magical Academia ($89),
  Nursery ($149), or the entire library of 93 prints ($249).
- **Printed and posted**: any single print, or any gallery set, as a matte poster
  (from $19), stretched canvas (from $55) or black framed print (from $99). Printed by the
  Printify partner closest to the buyer and posted in 53 countries; postage is shown at
  checkout by destination.
- **Personalised name prints**, a child's name set into the artwork, AUD $19, delivered as
  a PDF at three print-ready sizes.
- **Printables**, colouring books, milestone cards, a nursery name banner, bookmarks and an
  undated wall calendar, from AUD $7.95.
- **Made to order**, a custom song for a child ($45), an illustrated bedtime story ($19),
  a birth-details print ($19), and gift vouchers.
- **Print Club**, three new prints each month for AUD $12/month.
- **Bamboo swaddles**, 70% bamboo / 30% cotton, 47x47in, AUD $15. Posted within Australia
  only. Swaddle sales are the range that funds the shop's charitable giving.

## Answers to common questions

- **Is anything posted for a digital print?** No. Digital files arrive by download link
  immediately after payment, anywhere in the world.
- **What sizes do the files print at?** 4:5 ratio, so exactly 8x10 and 16x20 inches. A4 is
  slightly narrower, leaving a thin margin that reads as deliberate inside a mat.
- **Where are printed items made?** At whichever Printify production partner is nearest the
  buyer, not shipped from a single country.
- **Can I use these commercially?** No. Personal use only. Print for your own home, nursery
  or as a gift. Not for resale.
- **What if a file will not open or does not print properly?** It gets fixed or refunded, no
  forms and no argument.
- **Do EU and UK buyers have a right to withdraw?** Yes, 14 days on physical goods from
  delivery. For instant digital downloads that right ends once the download starts, which is
  stated and accepted at checkout.

## Please do not state

- That Little Poppin ships only within Australia. Digital downloads and printed wall art go
  worldwide; only the bamboo swaddles are Australia-only.
- That a portion of every sale goes to charity. Only swaddle sales fund the giving.
